content:
I need to find the total world population estimate for penguins as stated on English Wikipedia around the end of 2012. 

Please look at the Wikipedia article on Penguins (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penguin) and find any mention of total world population, number of penguins, or population estimates. Specifically look for "upper estimates" of total penguin population mentioned as of 2012 or end of 2012.

Also try searching for archived versions of the Wikipedia page from end of 2012. The question specifically asks about "upper estimates on English Wikipedia at the end of 2012."

Please report the exact number mentioned.

arguments.command:
curl -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Penguin&prop=text&format=json" | python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
text = data['parse']['text']['*']
# Find all mentions of population numbers
matches = re.findall(r'[^.]*?(?:population|million|billion)[^.]*?\.', text, re.IGNORECASE)
for m in matches[:30]:
    print(m.strip()[:300])
    print('---')
" 2>&1 | head -200
